name: com.modernwestern.observer-vm
description:
Zero-allocation, strongly typed MVVM bindings for Unity UI (UGUI + TextMeshPro), inspired by Unreal's UMG.
Views derive from Widget<TViewModel>, ViewModels expose Observable<T> properties and Commands, and bindings are declared once with Bind.Text, Bind.Value, Bind.Click...

samples.description: A player HUD (Widget) bound to a PlayerViewModel: text, fill, two-way slider and toggle, and a Command button. Requires TextMeshPro.
